comment: Known-answer tasks on the Notes sample (samples/Notes, built by the solution): {v1} and {v2} are the copied Notes.dll of each version. Each answer is graded by regexes on its ANSWER line (case-insensitive, all must match). Set 'check' is the one-question client check; 'bench' is the token benchmark.

tasks.prompt: The program in {v1} has a fixed list of notes. How many notes does it hold?
The program in {v1} has a fixed list of notes. What is the exact title of the note with id 2?
Which command-line commands does the program in {v1} accept (the first argument)? List them all.
What exit code does the program in {v1} return for an unknown command?
The program in {v1} has a fixed list of notes. What are the title and creation date of the note with id 3?
What is the exact header line the CSV export of {v1} writes?
{v2} is a newer build of {v1}. What is the method PreviewGate.Verify of the old build called in the new build?
{v2} is a newer build of {v1}. CsvExporter.Quote of the old build was renamed in the new build. What is its new name?
{v2} is a newer build of {v1}. Which note was added to the fixed note list in the new build? Give its id, title and date.
{v2} is a newer build of {v1}. In the old build the string decoder D(string, int) is in the type Notes.Strings. Which type declares it in the new build?
